review_method: Static source and diff review; AST literal inspection of the closed replacement list and read-only baseline occurrence counts. Neither module.verify nor the publication checker was run.

original_finding.description: The initial revised comparator accepted arbitrary nonmath prose changes throughout the two edited parts, subject only to statement-kind inventory, proof-body equality and math-span equality. Its changed-file allowlist was broader than the six approved prose corrections.
original_finding.example: Deleting the prose hypothesis twice continuously differentiable in a strengthened theorem would not have changed delimited mathematics or proof bodies.
original_finding.resolution: APPROVED_REPLACEMENTS is a closed list. For every part, the comparator applies each approved old/new substitution exactly once to the retrieved baseline, rejects missing/nonunique matches, and requires complete expected-file equality with the current part.
